text:
[LGRA.5.1] Schema productions:

```
schema_decl ::= 'schema' NAME schema_lifecycle? ':' NEWLINE
                INDENT
                    docstring?
                    field_decl+
                DEDENT

schema_lifecycle ::= 'scope' scope_value
scope_value      ::= 'explicit'
                  |  'activation'
                  |  'logical' 'ambient'?
                  |  'ttl' time_expr 'ambient'?

field_decl ::= NAME ':' field_type NULLABLE? field_capacity? slot_marker* field_tolerance? STRING_LIT? NEWLINE

field_capacity ::= 'capacity' INT_LIT                          # String slots only; see [LSTR.11]

field_type ::= TYPE_SYM
            # TYPE_SYM resolves in the type namespace (LGRA.22): a scalar builtin
            # (String/Int/Float/Bool/Bytes), Json, a unit symbol, a
            # dimension or scalar-group name (LUNI.7.1), or a schema reference. Nullable slot: field_type NULLABLE? (`state: String?`).

slot_marker ::= 'retained' | 'key' | 'mutable'     # retained per SCOPE / FORM_CATALOG; key/mutable per LFAC.1.7

field_tolerance ::= 'tolerance' (INT_LIT | FLOAT_LIT)          # unsigned, no unit; see [LGRA.5.9]

docstring ::= STRING_LIT NEWLINE
```
